verdict.rationale: The probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec at clerk.com/openapi.json, which is the foundation for an API reference and could be loaded into third-party tools to explore and run calls. The MCP server and CLI give agents SDK snippets, but nothing in the evidence shows a first-party interactive reference or runnable examples. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API reference UI, runnable or try-it examples, documentation of the reference experience, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
